title: 台積電 GIGAFAB 廠務整合案例
summary: 從工廠與供應鏈、振動與基礎到公開案例審查：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Fab and supply chain and Vibration and foundations to Public-case review: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 工廠與供應鏈 → 超純水回路
stages.titleEn: Fab and supply chain to Ultrapure-water loop
stages.description: 把「工廠與供應鏈」「公用系統接口」「超純水回路」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Fab and supply chain, Utility interfaces, Ultrapure-water loop.

steps.title: 工廠與供應鏈：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe.
steps.instruction: 畫設計、晶圓製造、封裝與測試邊界，不填入未公開管線。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw design, fab, packaging and test boundaries without inventing utility layouts. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方；廠區公開位置不等於內部設備座標。
steps.observationEn: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe; Public fab locations do not expose tool positions.
steps.failure: 若採用「用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring identical internal flows from a company name", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「工廠與供應鏈」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Fab and supply chain diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「台積電 GIGAFAB 廠務整合案例」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「工廠與供應鏈：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：集中廠務總量會隱藏局部瓶頸與切換風險。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「晶圓城夜班：來料、廠務與搬運」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：台積電 GIGAFAB 廠務整合案例 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「集中廠務總量會隱藏局部瓶頸與切換風險」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use TSMC GIGAFAB facility-integration case study as the task boundary. After reading “Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Aggregate facility totals can hide local bottlenecks and switching risks. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Wafer City night shift: incoming material, utilities and logistics”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for TSMC GIGAFAB facility-integration case study: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Aggregate facility totals can hide local bottlenecks and switching risks” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「工廠與供應鏈」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Fab and supply chain, which inference has a physical basis?
options: GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方
用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同
只比較總供應量就保證設備可運作
optionsEn: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe
Inferring identical internal flows from a company name
Guaranteeing tool operation from supply quantity alone
quiz.explanation: GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 工廠與供應鏈：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fab and supply chain: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Inferring identical internal flows from a company name.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「工廠與供應鏈」成果，先指出錯誤主張「用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：廠區公開位置不等於內部設備座標。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Fab and supply chain artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Inferring identical internal flows from a company name". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Public fab locations do not expose tool positions. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方；廠區公開位置不等於內部設備座標。
steps.observationEn: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe; Public fab locations do not expose tool positions.
steps.failure: 若採用「用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring identical internal flows from a company name", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「工廠與供應鏈」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「廠區公開位置不等於內部設備座標」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Fab and supply chain, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Public fab locations do not expose tool positions" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同」與「GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

quiz.questionEn: Which additional factor belongs in a check of Ultrapure-water loop?
options: 只用市政水質標準代表晶圓接觸水
空氣看不見塵便證明所有污染受控
回流監測也需考慮管路停滯
optionsEn: Using municipal-water criteria for wafer-contact water
Treating invisible dust as proof all contamination is controlled
quiz.explanation: 回流監測也需考慮管路停滯；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Return monitoring must consider stagnation. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.
